tools.name: list_prompt_suggestions
tools.description: Get the canonical catalog of suggested workflows for this Kit account.

tools.name: get_current_account
tools.description: Get details for the authenticated Kit account.

tools.name: list_colors
tools.description: Get the brand color palette for this Kit account.

tools.name: update_colors
tools.description: Replace the brand color palette for this Kit account.

tools.name: get_creator_profile
tools.description: Get the creator's newsletter site information.

tools.name: get_email_stats
tools.description: Get account-level email sending statistics (averages across the whole account, last 90 days), not per-broadcast stats. For one broadcast's performance use get_stats_for_a_broadcast; for many broadcasts at once use get_stats_for_a_list_of_broadcasts.

tools.name: get_growth_stats
tools.description: Get subscriber growth statistics for the account.

tools.name: bulk_create_subscribers
tools.description: Create or update multiple subscribers in a single call (upsert by email address). Use this instead of calling create_subscriber repeatedly.

tools.name: bulk_update_subscriber_custom_field_values
tools.description: Update custom field values for multiple subscribers in a single call. Use this instead of calling update_subscriber repeatedly.

tools.name: create_subscriber
tools.description: Create or update a single subscriber (upsert by email address). For creating more than one subscriber, use bulk_create_subscribers instead.

tools.name: filter_subscribers
tools.description: Filter subscribers by engagement (opens, clicks, sends, deliveries), sign-up date, subscriber state, tag membership, primary location, and/or original signup attribution. Results can be enriched via include (tags, location, attribution, or engagement stats over a window).

tools.name: get_subscriber
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific subscriber by ID.

tools.name: list_stats_for_a_subscriber
tools.description: Get engagement statistics for a specific subscriber by ID. Returns (under subscriber.stats ): sent , opened , clicked , bounced , open_rate , click_rate , last_sent , last_opened , last_clicked , sends_since_last_open , sends_since_last_click . Use email_sent_after / email_sent_before (YYYY-MM-DD) to scope to a date range.

tools.name: list_subscribers
tools.description: List subscribers with optional filtering, enrichment, and cursor pagination. Use include to enrich each subscriber: fields adds custom field values; tags , location , attribution , and canceled_at add their respective data in a single call.

tools.name: list_tags_for_a_subscriber
tools.description: List all tags applied to a specific subscriber.

tools.name: unsubscribe
tools.description: Unsubscribe a subscriber from the account.

tools.name: update_subscriber
tools.description: Update a single subscriber's details (email, name, or custom fields). For updating custom fields on more than one subscriber, use bulk_update_subscriber_custom_field_values instead.

tools.name: bulk_create_tags
tools.description: Create multiple tags in a single call (upsert by name). Use this instead of calling create_tag repeatedly when setting up a tag taxonomy or importing many tags at once.

tools.name: bulk_delete_tags
tools.description: Delete multiple tags in a single call by ID. Use this to clean up a tag taxonomy or remove tags in bulk.

tools.name: bulk_remove_tags_from_subscribers
tools.description: Remove a tag from multiple subscribers in a single call. Prefer this over repeated remove_tag_from_subscriber calls when untagging more than a handful of subscribers.

tools.name: bulk_tag_subscribers
tools.description: Apply a tag to multiple subscribers in a single call. Prefer this over repeated tag_subscriber calls when tagging more than a handful of subscribers.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag. For creating more than one tag, use bulk_create_tags instead.

tools.name: list_subscribers_for_tag
tools.description: List all subscribers who have a specific tag. Returns a slim response by default; add "fields" to include when you need custom field values.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in the account. Add subscriber_count to include to also get each tag's active subscriber count.

tools.name: remove_tag_from_subscriber
tools.description: Remove a tag from a subscriber. For removing a tag from more than one subscriber at once, use bulk_remove_tags_from_subscribers instead.

tools.name: tag_subscriber
tools.description: Apply a tag to a subscriber. For tagging more than one subscriber at once, use bulk_tag_subscribers instead.

tools.name: update_tag_name
tools.description: Rename an existing tag.

tools.name: list_segments
tools.description: List all subscriber segments (saved subscriber filters) in the account.

tools.name: bulk_create_custom_fields
tools.description: Create multiple custom field definitions in a single call (upsert by label). Use this instead of calling create_custom_field repeatedly when setting up a new account or importing a field schema.

tools.name: create_custom_field
tools.description: Create a new custom field. For creating more than one custom field, use bulk_create_custom_fields instead.

tools.name: delete_custom_field
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom field and its values from all subscribers.

tools.name: list_custom_fields
tools.description: List all custom fields defined in the account.

tools.name: update_custom_field
tools.description: Rename an existing custom field.

tools.name: add_subscriber_to_form
tools.description: Subscribe someone to a form. For subscribing more than one subscriber, use bulk_add_subscribers_to_forms instead.

tools.name: bulk_add_subscribers_to_forms
tools.description: Subscribe multiple existing subscribers to one or more forms in a single call, triggering the form's confirmation or incentive email for each. Use this instead of calling add_subscriber_to_form repeatedly for onboarding or lead-import workflows.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List all forms and landing pages in the account. Add subscriber_count to include to also get each form's active subscriber count.

tools.name: list_subscribers_for_form
tools.description: List subscribers who signed up through a specific form. Returns a slim response by default; add "fields" to include when you need custom field values.

tools.name: add_subscriber_to_sequence
tools.description: Add a subscriber to an email sequence. Creates the subscriber if they don't exist.

tools.name: create_sequence
tools.description: Create a new email sequence (automated email series).

tools.name: delete_sequence
tools.description: Permanently delete a sequence. All subscribers will be removed from the sequence.

tools.name: get_sequence
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific sequence. Add "stats" to include to also get deliverability counts and rates (opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes) plus the unsubscriber count (matches the sequences dashboard).

tools.name: list_sequences
tools.description: List all email sequences (automated email series) in the account. Add "stats" to include to also get per-sequence deliverability counts and rates (opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes) plus the unsubscriber count (matches the sequences dashboard).

tools.name: list_subscribers_for_sequence
tools.description: List subscribers in a specific sequence. Returns a slim response by default; add "fields" to include when you need custom field values.

tools.name: update_sequence
tools.description: Update an existing sequence's settings.

tools.name: create_sequence_email
tools.description: Add a new email to a sequence.

tools.name: delete_sequence_email
tools.description: Remove an email from a sequence. Remaining emails are automatically re-ordered.

tools.name: get_sequence_email
tools.description: Get a specific email within a sequence, including its HTML content. Add "stats" to include to also get this email's deliverability counts and rates (opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes).

tools.name: list_sequence_emails
tools.description: List all emails in a specific sequence, ordered by position. Content is omitted by default; pass include_content: true to include it. Add "stats" to include for per-email deliverability counts and rates (opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes).

tools.name: update_sequence_email
tools.description: Update an existing sequence email. Only fields you provide are changed (patch semantics).

tools.name: create_broadcast
tools.description: Create a draft email broadcast.

tools.name: delete_broadcast
tools.description: Delete a broadcast. Cannot delete broadcasts that are sending or completed.

tools.name: get_broadcast
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific broadcast.

tools.name: get_link_clicks_for_a_broadcast
tools.description: Get click data for a specific broadcast.

tools.name: get_stats_for_a_broadcast
tools.description: Get performance statistics for a single broadcast by ID. Requires a broadcast ID; use list_broadcasts first to find IDs. For stats across many broadcasts at once, use get_stats_for_a_list_of_broadcasts.

tools.name: get_stats_for_a_list_of_broadcasts
tools.description: Performance analytics across many broadcasts at once. Use this when the goal is performance analysis or building a stats leaderboard across multiple sends. This is not the listing tool: to browse or find broadcasts, use list_broadcasts. For the stats of a single broadcast, use get_stats_for_a_broadcast after finding its ID with list_broadcasts.

tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.description: List all broadcasts (email campaigns) in the account. Add "content" to include when you need full details (HTML content, targeting) across many broadcasts at once.

tools.name: update_broadcast
tools.description: Update an existing broadcast's content (subject, body, preview text, segment, template, etc.).

tools.name: list_email_templates
tools.description: List all email templates available in the account.

tools.name: list_snippets
tools.description: List all snippets in the account.

tools.name: get_snippet
tools.description: Get a specific snippet by ID, including its content and document.

tools.name: create_snippet
tools.description: Create a new reusable snippet.

tools.name: update_snippet
tools.description: Update an existing snippet. Only fields you provide are changed (patch semantics).

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific post.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List all published posts on the creator's newsletter site.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the account's Commerce products — everything the creator sells, including tip jars.

tools.name: list_tax_codes
tools.description: List the Kit tax codes used to classify a product's tax category, i.e. to choose a product's tax_code_id when creating or updating a product.

tools.name: get_purchase
tools.description: Get details about a specific purchase.

tools.name: list_purchases
tools.description: List all purchases tracked in the account.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the account's domains.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook that fires HTTP requests to an external URL when events occur.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook. It will stop firing for all future events.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List all webhooks configured in the account.
